title: Ensure the PostgreSQL Audit Extension (pgAudit) is enabled
rationale: The pgAudit extension provides detailed session and object audit logging, improving accountability and supporting security investigations.
remediation: Install the pgAudit extension, add it to shared_preload_libraries if required, restart PostgreSQL, then execute CREATE EXTENSION pgaudit;.

title: Ensure the pgcrypto extension is installed and configured correctly
rationale: The pgcrypto extension provides cryptographic functions for securely storing and processing sensitive information.
remediation: Install the pgcrypto extension by executing CREATE EXTENSION pgcrypto; if it is available in the PostgreSQL installation.
